weakness_curse.subject: a lone human knight in dented steel plate armor with a faded blue tabard and a plain round steel helmet, holding a straight steel sword, kneeling on one knee with his head bowed, his right gauntlet gripping the hilt of his one sword whose tip rests on the ground, his left hand pressed flat on his raised knee. A thin crack runs down the blade, and a thin veil of dark purple smoke rises from the crack and drifts up behind his shoulders.
